address: Scottish National Gallery, The Mound, Edinburgh,EH2 2EL
bio: The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant is located at the Scottish National Gallery, in the shadow of Edinburgh Castle, with views east across Princes Street Gardens.  The Scottish Cafe & Restaurant is run by Victor and Carina Contini, who are committed to sustainable practices and buy direct from a trusted network of over 70 Scottish artisan suppliers.  Enjoy a leisurely Afternoon Tea, with a selection of sandwiches, including Grierson’s Organic Egg & cress and Ramsay of Carluke ham & Uncle Roy’s mustard. Isle of Mull cheese scone is served with Heatherfield Smoked Salmon, along with fruit scones, jam and whipped cream.  The daily selection of petit fours includes Mini Apple Pie, Pistacchio Macarons, Empire Biscuit and Chocolate Opera Cake.  A Vegetarian Afternoon Tea menu is also available.  Access to the Scottish Cafe & Restaurant is via the East Princes Street Gardens Entrance.
